reviews.text: Kaitlyn is absolutely amazing. She’s so good with all of the dogs and you can tell they all love her!
Great caring staff, my dog loves this place

Excellent groom by Kim! Can’t wait to try out doggy daycare here. Love the online/app based scheduling too. (Ok updated- daycare is amazing and my dog loves it so much she doesn’t even mind being groomed after a long play session with her daycare friends!)
Bon loves the staff, the belly rubs, frolicking with friends, and definitely snuffle mat time.

What a GODSEND!! We are from up north, our son was graduating Marine Bootcamp we brought his puppy Maya May & then realized we weren’t able to leave her alone in our hotel due to her barking (she doesn’t like being alone) I contacted wags & ruffs late the evening before and they got right back to me.

Upon Maya’s arrival she was greeted and shown affection from everyone of her daycare guardians 🥹 she even picked out some snacks & toys for her stay and went off to her private suite. The following day we thought we’d try & give her a chance to experience the group day care. Her guardians REALLY took the time to introduce her and gave her time to warm up to the community they also assess which pups Maya vibes with lol. When picking Maya up, she was so happy not scared or anxious. I know our pup! If she was unhappy or miserable or mistreated then she would have let me know LOL especially with her body language but Instead she greeted us with happiness excitement and all was even excited to go back!!! If I could give wags & ruffs a 100 star ⭐️ rating I would!!!!!

Thank you from the bottom of hearts!! We will ALWAYS be bring our pets back to you doggy daycare every time we are back in San Diego!!
Kim did a great job with 6 month old Cooper . It was his first time . He looks so cute . I definitely recommend to take your pups to Wags and Ruffs
Wags and Ruff is amazing with our fur baby. They always give him specialized attention, are amazing communicators and extremely trustworthy. We love sending Zoro there knowing he is in great hands.

Love this place! Recently moved into the area and needed a place that could look after our senior dog and energetic youngster. This was the Goldilocks place after a couple of other tries, as the pups are always happy after boarding and get their play fix.

Love that they have a lot of options for boarding- private/connecting suite and playroom stay. This helps as our older dog is finicky and sometimes needs his space. The staff is always friendly and LOVE the daily report cards from daycare. Thank you!

This review is long overdue! Our dog has been a regular at Wags and Ruffs since he was just four months old (now four years old) and it is such a comfort knowing he is always in the best hands and surrounded by great company. From the kindness of the front desk staff, to the love and care he receives during enrichment activities, to the hilarious report cards and photos, and to the skills he has learned from the trainer, Julia, it is clear how genuinely invested they are in every dog. Being able to get his nails trimmed and other grooming done while he is at daycare makes our lives so much easier, thanks to Kim.

Our dog adores his human and pup friends at Wags and Ruffs and is always excited to go see them. We credit everyone there with helping us raise our sweet pup and are beyond grateful to have found such a special place. If you are looking for an exceptional home away from home for your dog, this is it. I would selfishly love to keep it a secret, but it is impossible not to brag about how incredible Wags and Ruffs is.
Great place with open space boarding so your dogs are never in cages. The staff is really great. One of the only places I trust to take care of my dog.
Horrible service, my pet came out intensely sick, malnourished ect.. I wouldn’t recommend this place to my worst enemy Buyer beware

I’m so glad i found Wags & Ruffs. If i could give them 1000 5 star reviews, I would! The attention to detail in their services they provide is amazing, and I love getting daily report cards on how my dog is doing when he is with them. I love that there are daycare and boarding options if I need just a day of care or a week of care. I haven’t had any issues with the team during any of my dogs stays. Zion was shy at first but he’s really gotten comfortable there. 10000/10 recommend! We travel a little far to use Wags & Ruffs but it’s completely worth it. You can tell they really care about your dogs health and wellbeing here.

After frantically trying to find a two night stay (our go  to place was booked) during Thanksgiving,  a friend recommended W & R. After the initial stay they were able to accommodate Larry during the holiday! They took this photo for his report card and I melted.
Update: Larry's 3 day stay at Wags and Ruffs over Thanksgiving was fantastic, Jen and her team instantly became his new home away from home!!! Thank you so much for accommodating our goofball on such short notice.

Great daycare with lovely staff.
Always take my girl there when in San Diego for work.
They take good care and provide lots of pics.

Great, trustworthy staff, my dog absolutely loves coming here for daycare. Everyone we interact with makes the effort to learn your name and recognizes pups on sight, even if it’s been a while since your last visit! The daily report cards are a highlight :)

Love this doggie day care!  They are so sweet and kind to our pets.  Love that they offer report cards during their stay.  For the love and care they receive the price is amazing.  Thanks for caring for my sweet boy Cooper like he was your own!

So grateful to have found Wags & Ruffs! Our dog, Barley, has been attending daycare here for about a month and it's already a key resource to us as dog parents. The staff are kind, know our dog as an individual, and send the best photos and report cards. To quote my friend with a toddler "they send you a much more comprehensible report than I get for my child." Barley starts howling and pulling to get inside the second we park, so she clearly loves it as well. Wags & Ruffs gets the recommendation of all humans and dogs in this pack!

Wags and Ruffs has been great with my dog Indy. He has been to daycare over a dozen times and then did a night of boarding and it went great. I highly recommend them and get a report card so you receive daily photos and write ups about your pups day and/or night there!
Our poodle mix dog always looks wonderful after a grooming with Kim. She’s gentle with him too as he’s aging and more sensitive.
They are so friendly and accommodating here. My dog also really likes playing with the other dogs and comes home so happy after doggy daycare!
Thank you!!
Thank you! :)
My pup did great on her first days of daycare! She is a nervous girl for sure but they took time with her and she did well! I’m so proud of her!! Thanks Wags team!

We absolutely love Wags & Ruffs! Stellar employees and team!
Thank you for all you do!
